subject: economics
title: Spot the Difference Adventure
welcome_lead: What do you need? What do you just want? ✅
meta_desc: Needs vs Wants Adventure 1 — KS3 Economics on the basic difference between needs and wants.
final_note: You learned to spot needs vs wants and why it matters for spending.

concepts.def: Nice to have but not vital

walkthroughs.body_html:
A need is something you must have to live or function:

  • Food and water.
  • Clothes.
  • Shelter.
  • School.

These are essentials. 🥪

A want is something nice to have:

  • Designer trainers.
  • Latest console.
  • Cinema trip.
  • Holiday.

These are luxuries. 🎮

Smart spending puts priority on needs first.

Pay for the school trip lunch before the new game.

Once needs are sorted, wants are fun.

numericals.q: Pocket money £10. Lunch (need) £4. Spare for wants, in £?
